text_block_list.text: One day, in the academy hallway――

Air Groove stood pondering something
as she looked at a stack of cardboard boxes at the end of the hallway.
choice_data_list: What on earth are all these cardboard boxes...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you, don't just wander over carelessly.
Don't worry, I'm cleaning it up right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is a pile of discarded notices, collected rental umbrellas,
and damaged school property.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As the student council, we will reorganize these in a separate room.
choice_data_list: Carrying this alone takes some serious muscle.
Carrying this alone takes some serious muscle.
To get through this amount, we'll need to hurry quite a bit...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As the student council, we will reorganize these in a separate room.
choice_data_list: Carrying this alone takes some serious muscle.
Carrying this alone takes some serious muscle.
To get through this amount, we'll need to hurry quite a bit...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Is that supposed to be concern?
So long as one trains constantly, this is effortless.

Air Groove effortlessly lifted the stack of cardboard boxes
and strode off just like that.

Her footing was rock solid, making it clear
just how thoroughly conditioned her entire body was.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph. If I cannot dispatch trivialities of this caliber with haste—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Neither as the Empress nor as the Student Council Vice President
do I have any right to stand before everyone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Enough idle chatter. Rather than worrying about me, do what you are meant to do.

Air Groove effortlessly lifted the stack of cardboard boxes
and strode off just like that.

Even while carrying something so large, not a single step was wasted,
offering a glimpse into her everyday flawlessness.
